tokens.name: plum-black
tokens.usage: Brand. Body text in light theme (via `ink`), the page ground in dark theme (via `paper`). Never a fill for small controls.

tokens.name: plum-deep
tokens.usage: Brand. Hover/pressed state for plum buttons in light theme; raised surfaces (sheets, popovers) in dark theme.

tokens.name: plum
tokens.usage: Brand. The primary action color in light theme: primary buttons, active nav tab, links, the Done pill. White text on it is 13.3:1.

tokens.name: steel
tokens.usage: Brand neutral. Decorative only in light theme (map water, photo placeholders, dividers on dark blocks); fails as text on white (2.3:1). In dark theme it is the metadata text color (`ink-3`).

tokens.name: mint
tokens.usage: Brand highlight. Means 'planned / in the plan': Planned pill, filled slot marker, drop target in dark theme. Always with `plum-black` text on it (12.1:1), never white.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background. Light is steel tinted to 15%.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, header bar, inputs.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Day columns on the Days board, table group rows, the Want pill ground.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets, menus, the dragged card.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Card borders and row dividers (decorative, 1px).

tokens.name: control-border
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, selects, secondary buttons and checkboxes: 3.6:1 on `surface` light, 4.6:1 dark.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on `paper`, `surface`, `surface-sunken` in both themes (17:1+).

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: descriptions, detail lines under names. On `paper`, `surface`, `surface-sunken` (≥9:1).

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Metadata and mono labels (MORNING, DAY 2 OF 4), field labels. 5.3:1 on `paper`, 4.8:1 on `surface-sunken` light; 7.5:1+ dark.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Links, primary button fill, active nav tab, selected segment, checked checkbox. Plum in light, mint in dark.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of anything `accent`.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an `accent` fill.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px solid keyboard focus ring with a 2px `paper` gap. 11:1+ on every surface.

tokens.name: planned-bg
tokens.usage: Planned status pill background.

tokens.name: planned-ink
tokens.usage: Text on `planned-bg` (12:1 light, 8.2:1 dark).

tokens.name: done-bg
tokens.usage: Done status pill background.

tokens.name: done-ink
tokens.usage: Text on `done-bg`.

tokens.name: want-bg
tokens.usage: Want and Skipped pill background.

tokens.name: want-ink
tokens.usage: Text on `want-bg`.

tokens.name: drop-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of a day slot while a card is dragged over it.

tokens.name: drop-line
tokens.usage: 2px dashed border of the active drop target.

tokens.name: warn-bg
tokens.usage: Warning alert fill: needs checking (hours unconfirmed, needs a booking, only chance this trip).

tokens.name: warn-line
tokens.usage: Warning alert border.

tokens.name: warn-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icon on `warn-bg`; also inline 'Hours unconfirmed' text on `surface` (9.7:1 light).

tokens.name: crit
tokens.usage: Conflicts: closed that day, slot overlaps airport time. Solid alert fill and the 2px card outline. On `surface` 6.5:1 / 7.4:1.

tokens.name: on-crit
tokens.usage: Text on a `crit` fill.

tokens.name: crit-bg
tokens.usage: Soft critical fill for inline form errors.

tokens.name: ok-ink
tokens.usage: Confirmed facts: '✓ Daily 10 am–6 pm' hours line, saved messages. On `surface` and `ok-bg`.

tokens.name: ok-bg
tokens.usage: Soft success fill.

tokens.name: info-bg
tokens.usage: Info alert fill: time-based reminders (check-in closes, swap seats).

tokens.name: info-line
tokens.usage: Info alert border.

tokens.name: info-ink
tokens.usage: Text on `info-bg`.
